versions.content: Name FiM_ConfigType Kind Structure  Type  Elements Comment implementation specific Description This type defines a data structure for the post build parameters of the FIM. At initialization the FIM gets a pointer to a structure of this type to get access to its configuration data, which is necessary for initializsation. Available via FiM.h
